clips.canonical_source_text: For me it was most beneficial after the first 10 minutes of being on my knees, because it starts to hurt and get uncomfortable and that makes you feel what you're thinking about, like actually you live it.
clips.human_approved_source_text: For me it was most beneficial after the first 10 minutes of being on my knees, because it starts to hurt and get uncomfortable and that makes you feel what you're thinking about, feel what you're saying, like actually you live it.
